Move method tryRunListener to org.redisson.RedissonLockEntry
Rationale: The method tryRunListener(RedissonLockEntry value) directly interacts with the listeners associated with a RedissonLockEntry instance. Since the method is responsible for executing the listeners that are part of the RedissonLockEntry's state, it logically belongs to the RedissonLockEntry class. Moving this method to RedissonLockEntry enhances cohesion by keeping related functionality together, as it operates on the listeners queue that is a member of the RedissonLockEntry class.

candidates.description:
Move method tryRunAllListeners to org.redisson.RedissonLockEntry
Rationale: The method tryRunAllListeners(RedissonLockEntry value) is closely related to the management of listeners associated with a RedissonLockEntry instance. Since the method operates on the listeners queue of the RedissonLockEntry class, it is logical to move it there. This will enhance cohesion by keeping all listener-related functionality within the same class, making the code easier to understand and maintain. Additionally, it allows for better encapsulation of the listener management logic, as it directly interacts with the listeners field and methods like getListeners() and addListener().
